subject: Use shard-id of the master if the replica does not support shard-id (#12805)
reason: The only behavioral addition fires exclusively when a gossiping peer omits the shard-id ping extension, i.e. a pre-7.2 node that does not support shard-id. Both builds the fuzzer runs (the change at 4cae66f and its parent at 38f0234) emit the shard-id extension unconditionally (cluster_legacy.c:2538-2547, untouched by the diff), so in any homogeneous cluster the harness can build, ext_shardid is never NULL and the new branch at cluster_legacy.c:2615 is unreachable; there is no client command that produces a gossip message without the extension. The other hunk rewrites `while (n->slaveof != NUL
